cohort: Women with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) during delivery hospitalizations in the United States from 2000 to 2019
finding: The proportion of deliveries to women with SLE has increased over time in the US, and SLE and APS are associated with a broad range of adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Systemic lupus erythematosus and antiphospholipid syndrome were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery in this study.
